tools.name: oblio_list_companies
tools.description: The companies (CIF, name, your access level) linked to the connected Oblio account. Good first call: every other tool needs a CIF from here. GET /api/nomenclature/companies.

tools.name: oblio_list_vat_rates
tools.description: VAT rates (name, percent, default) of a company; use the name and percent on document lines. GET /api/nomenclature/vat_rates.

tools.name: oblio_list_series
tools.description: Document series of a company (type Factura/Proforma/Aviz, name, start, next number, default). Use the name as series_name. GET /api/nomenclature/series.

tools.name: oblio_list_languages
tools.description: Foreign languages a company can issue documents in (code, name). GET /api/nomenclature/languages.

tools.name: oblio_list_management
tools.description: Stock managements (gestiuni) of a company with their work point and type; works only when stock is enabled. GET /api/nomenclature/management.

tools.name: oblio_list_clients
tools.description: Clients of a company, optionally filtered by name or client CIF. Up to 250 per page: pass next_offset as offset for the next page. GET /api/nomenclature/clients.

tools.name: oblio_list_products
tools.description: Products and services of a company with unit, price, VAT and (with stock) quantities. Up to 250 per page: pass next_offset as offset. GET /api/nomenclature/products.

tools.name: oblio_get_document
tools.description: One invoice, proforma or notice by series and number: type, series, number, link to the PDF and (invoices) the collections. GET /api/docs/<type>.

tools.name: oblio_list_invoices
tools.description: Invoices of a company with filters (series, number, dates, client, draft/canceled/collected), newest first by default. Optional products, collections and e-Factura (SPV) status per invoice. Pass next_offset as offset for the next page. GET /api/docs/invoice/list.

tools.name: oblio_list_webhooks
tools.description: The webhook subscriptions of the account (id, CIF, topic, endpoint). GET /api/webhooks.

tools.name: oblio_create_proforma
tools.description: Create a PROFORMA (not a fiscal invoice; the preferred first step). It takes the next number of the series immediately, there is no draft state, and Oblio sends no e-mail. Check client, lines, VAT (oblio_list_vat_rates) and series (oblio_list_series) first. Returns the series, number and a PDF link.

tools.name: oblio_issue_invoice
tools.description: ISSUE a real INVOICE. This is a legal fiscal document: it takes the next number in the series at once, there is no draft state, it cannot be edited, and it can only be cancelled afterwards (it may also be sent to ANAF e-Factura / SPV, automatically if the account is set up so). Needs confirm: true,

tools.name: oblio_collect_invoice
tools.description: Record that an issued invoice was paid (receipt, bank order, card...). Changes the invoice's paid status and is not reversible from the API. Needs confirm: true and the user's approval of the amount. Not retried. PUT /api/docs/invoice/collect.

tools.name: oblio_cancel_document
tools.description: CANCEL an invoice, proforma or notice. A cancelled invoice stays in the series but is void; if it was already sent to e-Factura / SPV, check the SPV side as well. Needs confirm: true and the user's approval. Not retried. PUT /api/docs/<type>/cancel.

tools.name: oblio_restore_document
tools.description: Restore a previously CANCELLED invoice, proforma or notice. Needs confirm: true and the user's approval. Not retried. PUT /api/docs/<type>/restore.

tools.name: oblio_send_einvoice_to_spv
tools.description: SEND an issued invoice to ANAF e-Factura (SPV). Irreversible: a document accepted by ANAF cannot be withdrawn from this API. Needs confirm: true and the user's approval. Not retried: check the status with oblio_list_invoices (with_einvoice_status) before repeating. Returns text, sent and a code (-1

tools.name: oblio_create_webhook
tools.description: Subscribe an HTTPS endpoint to an Oblio event (stock changes, drafts/updates/cancellations of documents, collections). Oblio will POST account data to that URL, so only use an endpoint the user named and controls; it must answer 200 with the base64 of the X-Oblio-Request-Id header. Needs confirm: tr

tools.name: oblio_delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook subscription by id (from oblio_list_webhooks). Needs confirm: true. DELETE /api/webhooks/{id}.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "oblio_list_products" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: cif, name, code, management, work_station, include_unsalable, offset

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: oblio_list_languages, oblio_create_proforma, oblio_send_einvoice_to_spv · Private data: oblio_list_vat_rates, oblio_list_series, oblio_list_languages, oblio_get_document, oblio_issue_invoice, oblio_collect_invoice, oblio_cancel_document, oblio_restore_document, oblio_send_einvoice_to_spv, oblio_create_webhook · Public sink: oblio_list_webhooks, oblio_create_proforma, oblio_issue_invoice, oblio_send_einvoice_to_spv, oblio_create_webhook, oblio_delete_webhook · Destructive: oblio_delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: oblio_list_languages, oblio_create_proforma, oblio_send_einvoice_to_spv · Private data: oblio_list_vat_rates, oblio_list_series, oblio_list_languages, oblio_get_document, oblio_issue_invoice, oblio_collect_invoice, oblio_cancel_document, oblio_restore_document, oblio_send_einvoice_to_spv, oblio_create_webhook · Public sink: oblio_list_webhooks, oblio_create_proforma, oblio_issue_invoice, oblio_send_einvoice_to_spv, oblio_create_webhook, oblio_delete_webhook · Destructive: oblio_delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
